video_title: NBA Expansion to Mexico City? Adam Silver's Comments Change Everything

quotes.speaker: Adam Silver
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver on the potential for an NBA team in Mexico City
quotes.excerpt: Mexico City is the largest city in North America. It has a huge basketball base.
quotes.quote: Mexico City is the largest city in North America. It has a huge basketball base. We also point to a large Mexican-American population.
quotes.social_post: Adam Silver highlights Mexico City as a prime market for the NBA, citing its status as the largest city in North America and its massive basketball fan base.

structured.context: Adam Silver discusses the potential for an NBA expansion team in Mexico City due to its large population and basketball fan base.

quotes.speaker: Raúl Zárraga
quotes.summary_phrase: Raúl Zárraga on Mexico's massive NBA fan base
quotes.excerpt: Mexico has one of the largest NBA fan bases in Latin America.
quotes.quote: According to the NBA's data, 21.6 million fans in Mexico watched live NBA games during the 2025-2026 NBA season. Alongside Brazil, Mexico has one of the largest NBA fan bases in Latin America.
quotes.social_post: NBA data shows 21.6 million fans in Mexico watched live games during the 2025-2026 season, cementing the country as one of the league's largest fan bases in Latin America.

structured.context: Raúl Zárraga highlights the significant number of NBA fans in Mexico based on league data.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on the excitement of playing in Mexico City
quotes.excerpt: It's going to be a fun game and we're excited for the matchup.
quotes.quote: On behalf of obviously Nikola Jokić and a great team, Jamal Murray and all the guys over there, it's going to be a fun game and we're excited for the matchup.
quotes.social_post: Pascal Siakam says he and the Nuggets are excited for their upcoming matchup in Mexico City.

structured.context: Pascal Siakam expresses excitement about playing a game in Mexico City against Nikola Jokić and Jamal Murray.

quotes.speaker: Raúl Zárraga
quotes.summary_phrase: Raúl Zárraga on Mexico City's readiness for an NBA team
quotes.excerpt: The proximity, the time zone, the fans, the structure, the economy, everything else complies perfectly with the requirements.
quotes.quote: The proximity, the time zone, the fans, the structure, the economy, everything else complies perfectly with the requirements. Right now, the attention is completely dedicated to Las Vegas and Seattle.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: La cercanía, la zona horaria, la afición, la estructura, la economía, todo lo demás cumple perfectamente con los requisitos. Ahorita la atención está completamente dedicada a Las Vegas y Seattle.
quotes.social_post: Raul Zarraga says Mexico City meets all requirements for an NBA team, but notes the league's current focus remains on expansion in Las Vegas and Seattle.

structured.context: Raúl Zárraga explains that while Mexico City meets the requirements for an NBA team, the league is currently focused on Las Vegas and Seattle.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on the passion of Mexican basketball fans
quotes.excerpt: I think the Mexican people have that power, that passion in themselves.
quotes.quote: I think it's going to be great, you know. I think just because I think the Mexican people have that power, that passion in themselves. I think that the game is going to be amazing.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic praises the energy of Mexican basketball fans ahead of the game in Mexico City.

structured.context: Nikola Jokić shares his thoughts on the passion of basketball fans in Mexico ahead of a game.
